gloss: to bend back; to warp; to arch

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {反|そ}らしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to bend back; to arch; to warp
definitions.explanation: To cause something to curve or bend backward. Used for the body, back, and physical objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{背中|せなか}→背中：00810_senaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{反|そ}らす。
⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{反|そ}らして⟦ストレッチ→ストレッチ：05239_sutorecchi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I stretched by bending my body backward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{反|そ}らして⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: He walked proudly with his chest puffed out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湿気|しっけ}→湿気：03177_shikke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反|そ}って→反る：11967_soru⟧しまった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{重|おも}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{載|の}せて→載せる：28290_noseru⟧⟦{反|そ}らない→反る：11967_soru⟧ようにした。
examples.english: The board warped from humidity, so I put a weight on it to keep it from bending.

notes:
The transitive form of ⟦{反|そ}る→反る：11967_soru⟧ (to warp, to bend back). Most commonly used for arching the body or back. Also used for physical objects that bend or warp.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{背中|せなか}→背中：00810_senaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{反|そ}らす: to arch one's back
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{反|そ}らす: to bend one's body back
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{反|そ}らす: to puff out one's chest (with pride)
- ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{反|そ}らす: to arch one's lower back

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The intransitive counterpart is ⟦{反|そ}る→反る：11967_soru⟧ (to warp, to curve back). Note: the homophone ⟦{逸|そ}らす→逸らす：10362_sorasu⟧ means "to avert" (e.g., ⟦{目|め}を{逸|そ}らす→目を逸らす：18265_mewosorasu⟧ — to avert one's eyes) and is a different word.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反|そ}る→反る：11967_soru⟧: to warp, to bend back (intransitive)
- ⟦{曲|ま}げる→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧: to bend (more general, any direction)
- ⟦{逸|そ}らす→逸らす：10362_sorasu⟧: to avert, to divert (different meaning despite identical pronunciation)
